comment: The authorize endpoint answers request_not_supported, which the module accepts and skips on. JAR (RFC 9101) is refused in v1 by decision (register: authorization-and-interaction), so this entry is permanent until that decision changes.

No refresh token is issued: the refresh_token grant is post-skeleton work under #539 and the sample advertises only authorization_code. Delete this entry when #539 puts refresh tokens on an executed path.
